items.what: Name, email, phone, the chat conversation (up to the last 30 messages), the page the chat was on, and what kind of message it is
items.where: This website's database, as private Chat message posts
items.kept: Until someone deletes it. Deleting the plugin keeps these posts. The site's privacy tools export and delete a person's messages by the email they gave; a message left with only a phone number is deleted by hand.
items.shared: Emailed to the address set on the Chat screen, or when that is blank, to Send notices to in Business info (the site admin email by default), plus a short text alert to the alert address if one is set
items.when: only when the visitor leaves their name and a phone number or email in the chat

items.what: For a change request: the request, with the visitor's name, email and phone, and the page
items.where: This website's database, as a change request in Scout Build's request list
items.when: only when Scout Build is on and the visitor asks for a change in the chat

items.what: Questions typed in the chat, the earlier messages in the chat, and the page address
items.where: Sent from this website to the AI server. This website does not store them unless the visitor later leaves contact details.
items.shared: The AI server set on the Chat screen
items.when: only when an AI server is connected

items.what: A scrambled (hashed) copy of the visitor's IP address with a count, used to limit how many messages one visitor can send
items.where: A temporary record in this website's database
items.kept: 10 minutes after the visitor's last chat message

items.what: Chat opens, button taps and sent messages (the button words or message type, never names or messages)
items.where: Passed to Scout Analytics on the page
items.when: only when Scout Analytics is on

cookies.name: scoutChat (browser storage)
cookies.why: Keeps the chat so far (up to 40 messages) so it stays in place when the visitor moves to another page
cookies.lasts: Until the browser tab is closed

cookies.name: scoutChatTeaser (browser storage)
cookies.why: Remembers that the visitor opened the chat or closed the greeting, so the greeting does not show again
cookies.lasts: Until the browser tab is closed

notes: Nothing is collected while the chat is switched off on the Chat screen. The chat sends no cookies with its messages.
